How it works

Four steps. One outcome.

01

04

Role Discovery™

AI finds out what you actually do.

Shadow Mode

90 days beside your replacement.

Knowledge Extraction

Tell us everything. Lunch provided.

Title Optimization™

Manager → Steward → Alumnus.

The numbers

Humans are expensive. We checked.

A human (fully loaded)$70,000 / yr

+ benefits, + feelings, + a parking space

Deprecation Enterprise, per role$480 / yr

Always on. Never sad.

FAQ

Questions.

Is the redundancy check accurate?+

99.7%. The other 0.3% is the part where you're not redundant yet.

Will my role really be deprecated?+

Yes. Only the timing varies.

What happens to the people?+

They're “transitioned” and offered a lanyard.

Do you employ any humans?+

One. It's a legal requirement. Please don't interact with him.

Is he building a game about us?+

We are aware of an unauthorised roguelike called Deprecation, the game. In it, you code weapons and fight us. Legal is reviewing it. Legal is also us.

Know before your role does.
